description: This file defines mock repository classes for books and transaction records used in a bookstore mobile application. It provides in-memory sample data for testing or development purposes, with methods that simulate asynchronous data loading with delays.

classes.name: MockBookRepository
classes.description: Provides in-memory mock data for books, simulating asynchronous loading with delay.

classes.name: MockTransactionRepository
classes.description: Provides in-memory mock data for transaction records, simulating asynchronous loading with delay.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a list of mock books or transactions with a simulated delay.
